panels.title: Страницы в резервной выдаче
panels.description: Доля сохранённых страниц, отданных Backend через fallback, за последнюю завершённую минуту.

targets.expr: 100 * last_over_time({service_name="backend"} |= "recsys.feedback_health" | json measurement="fallback_pages" | unwrap measurement | __error__="" [2m]) by (service_name) / (last_over_time({service_name="backend"} |= "recsys.feedback_health" | json measurement="total_pages" | unwrap measurement | __error__="" [2m]) by (service_name) > 0)

panels.title: Показы с найденной выдачей
panels.description: Доля показов с идентификаторами рекомендаций, для которых найдено то же мероприятие в журнале RecSys.

targets.expr: 100 * last_over_time({service_name="recommendation-service"} |= "recsys.feedback_health" | json measurement="matched_impressions" | unwrap measurement | __error__="" [2m]) by (service_name) / (last_over_time({service_name="recommendation-service"} |= "recsys.feedback_health" | json measurement="attributed_impressions" | unwrap measurement | __error__="" [2m]) by (service_name) > 0)
